comment: Checked-in subset of CAVP/Wycheproof vectors and a deterministic local X.509 PKI.

suites.source: NIST CAVP shabytetestvectors (SHA256ShortMsg, SHA256LongMsg, SHA384ShortMsg, SHA512ShortMsg, SHA512LongMsg) subset
NIST CAVP SHA-3 byte test vectors (SHA3_256ShortMsg, SHA3_512ShortMsg, SHA3_256LongMsg) plus FIPS 202 SHAKE examples
C2SP Wycheproof hmac_sha256_test.json and hmac_sha512_test.json subset
C2SP Wycheproof hkdf_sha256_test.json and hkdf_sha512_test.json subset (RFC 5869 cases)
C2SP Wycheproof chacha20_poly1305_test.json subset (RFC 8439 vectors and negatives)
C2SP Wycheproof x25519_test.json subset (RFC 7748/8037 vectors and edge cases)
C2SP Wycheproof ecdh_secp256r1_test.json, ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256_test.json and RFC 6979 A.2.5 subset
C2SP Wycheproof rsa_signature_2048_sha256_test.json and rsa_pss_2048_sha256_mgf1_32_test.json subset
Deterministic local test PKI generated with OpenSSL 3.5 (see testdata/run/crypto_x509_pki.txtar)
NIST ACVP SLH-DSA-keyGen/sigGen/sigVer FIPS205 subset (SHA2-128s and SHA2-128f), plus malformed-signature cases
